full_prompt_en: A square color fashion photograph shows two women sitting back to back on a blue floor before a seamless turquoise-blue studio background. Both turn in opposite directions in calm side profile, their dark hair swept into smooth low buns. The woman on the left sits a little taller, with her chin lifted and hands resting on the broad spread of her skirt. Her long high-necked dress is brilliant red-orange, covered with dark branching floral pattern and bold cobalt-blue blossoms. A yellow-orange flower accent catches light near her shoulder. The skirt spills from her seat across the lower left and center of the image, creating a dense embroidered carpet of warm color and cool floral shapes. The woman on the right wears a simpler bright orange high-necked dress with a softly textured surface. She rests her hands in her lap, and her long skirt pools toward the lower right. Their shoulders nearly meet at the center, forming a quiet symmetrical axis, while the different skirt shapes keep the composition from feeling rigid. The uncluttered background has a gentle shift from deeper blue near the floor to brighter cyan above, leaving generous empty space around both profiles. Soft, controlled studio light gives the faces a pale smooth finish and brings out the woven or embroidered dress texture without harsh cast shadows. Fine red lips and dark brows supply small crisp facial accents. The photograph relies on saturated complementary color, polished silhouettes, and the contrast between a richly patterned textile and a simpler companion garment. The resulting mood is poised and graphic, with stillness and fabric doing most of the visual work.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色时装摄影呈现两名女子背靠背坐在蓝色地面上，身后是无缝的青蓝色影棚背景。两人以平静侧脸朝向相反方向，深色头发梳成光滑的低发髻。左侧女子坐得略高，微抬下巴，双手搭在大幅铺开的裙摆上。她的高领长裙是明亮的红橙色，布满深色枝状花纹和醒目的钴蓝色花朵。肩附近一处黄橙色花朵重音承接灯光。裙摆从座下延展至画面左下与中央，织成暖色和冷色花形交错的密集刺绣地毯。右侧女子穿一件更简洁的亮橙色高领长裙，表面有柔和织物肌理。她把双手放在膝上，长裙向右下方堆叠。两人的肩膀在中央几乎相接，形成安静的对称轴，而不同的裙摆轮廓避免构图僵硬。简洁背景从地面附近的较深蓝色轻微过渡到上方明亮青色，为两张侧脸留出宽裕空处。柔和且受控的影棚光使面孔呈现浅色平滑质感，也带出编织或刺绣裙料的纹理，没有刺眼的投影。细小的红唇和深眉提供清晰的面部点缀。摄影依靠饱和互补色、精致剪影，以及丰富图案织物和简洁同伴服装之间的对比。最终氛围端正而平面感鲜明，以静止姿态和布料担当主要视觉表达。
style_prompt_en: Polished color studio photography uses a nearly seamless cool backdrop as a broad field around carefully placed, still silhouettes. Highly saturated orange-red surfaces press forward against cyan and deep blue, while small cobalt and yellow accents create a vivid internal rhythm. One surface can carry dense, dark floral embroidery and oversized cool-toned motifs beside another with a quieter woven texture; the relationship between busy and plain areas matters more than literal decoration. Fabric spreads in low sweeping shapes across the foreground, anchoring upright forms and balancing a large area of uncluttered negative space above. Soft, even light models pale skin and textile folds with a smooth finish, avoiding hard shadows while retaining tactile detail. Clean profiles, restrained poses, and a near-symmetric central contact create graphic order. The image feels poised, intense, and editorial because color and textile pattern carry the energy within an otherwise spare composition.
style_prompt_zh: 精致的彩色影棚摄影用近乎无缝的冷色背景作大面积场域，围绕经过细心安排、保持静止的剪影。高饱和橙红表面从青色和深蓝色前突出，小块钴蓝与黄色点缀在内部形成鲜明节奏。一处表面可以承载密集的深色花卉刺绣和大幅冷色图案，旁边则配较安静的织物肌理；繁密与简素的面积关系比具体装饰物更重要。织物在前景铺出低矮而宽阔的曲线，托住直立形体，同时平衡上方大片整洁留白。柔和均匀的光线以平滑的完成度塑造浅色肤面与布料褶皱，避开硬阴影，却保留可触的细节。清楚的侧面轮廓、克制姿态和近乎对称的中央相接建立鲜明秩序。画面端正、强烈且富编辑摄影气质，因为色彩和织物纹样在本来简约的构图中承担了能量。
theme_en: Two women in vivid orange dresses sit back to back against a blue studio field
theme_zh: 两名穿鲜橙色长裙的女子背靠背坐在蓝色影棚背景前
name: Erik Madigan Heck
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
